workingTitle.en: How Can 0 and 1 Send a Message?

direction: Adapt the owner's thin-pipe story into a continuous illustrated adventure. Mia and Leo play between two treehouses, using an agreed two-symbol channel. A paper invitation cannot fit. They encode PLAY, find a hidden gift among ten boxes, and identify its fruit. Questions and replies are spoken in a shared room at the start of each round; the pipe carries only the answer bits. This keeps the yes/no questions intelligible without implying a bit can carry a whole question. English picture labels, two independent Louise tracks, no embedded subtitles or reserved subtitle band.

lines.zh: 米娅和里奥各坐一座树屋。今天，他们用小管子通信。
lines.en: Mia and Leo are playing in two treehouses. Today, their messages must go through a tiny pipe.

lines.zh: 米娅想邀请朋友来玩。可这张小纸条，怎么也塞不进去。
lines.en: Mia wants to invite her friend to play. But her little note will not fit.

lines.zh: 游戏规定，每次只能送一颗珠子。金色表示一，蓝色表示零。
lines.en: One little ball goes through at a time. Gold means one. Blue means zero.

lines.zh: 只靠这两种记号，你能把一句话传过去吗？
lines.en: Could you send a message with only those two kinds of signal?

lines.zh: 先看一颗珠子。它只有两种可能。
lines.en: Start with one little ball. It has just two possible values.

lines.zh: 两颗排在一起，就有四种不同的排法。顺序也算数。
lines.en: Put two in a row, and there are four different patterns. Their order matters.

lines.zh: 每个零或一，叫一个比特。现在，把八个比特排成一组。
lines.en: Each zero or one is called a bit. Now put eight bits in a group.

lines.zh: 这样一组叫一个字节。它有二百五十六种不同的排法。
lines.en: That group is a byte. It can have two hundred and fifty-six different patterns.

lines.zh: 两边用同一张表。开玩之前，就得约好每种排法代表什么。
lines.en: Before the game, they agreed on the same code table. Both ends must read it the same way.

lines.zh: 从右往左，每一格的数值翻一倍。右边是一，旁边是二，再旁边是四。
lines.en: Reading from right to left, each place is worth twice as much: one, two, four, and so on.

lines.zh: 只取六十四和一，加起来六十五。表里对应的是字母 A。
lines.en: Use the sixty-four and one places. That makes sixty-five: the letter A in their table.

lines.zh: 前面的零也要送。说好八颗一组，就收满八颗再读。
lines.en: Send the leading zeros too. They agreed to read a letter after all eight balls arrive.

lines.zh: 这次用阿斯基表，字母用八位来写。换别的表，就要按那张表的规矩。
lines.en: Here they use ASCII letters written with eight bits. Another code table could use different rules.

lines.zh: 米娅开始发邀请。第一个字母是 P，按编码表，一颗一颗送。
lines.en: Mia sends her invitation. The first letter is P. She sends its pattern, one ball at a time.

lines.zh: 接着是 L、A、Y。每收满八颗，里奥就在纸上写下一个字母。
lines.en: Then come L, A and Y. Every eight balls give Leo another letter to write down.

lines.zh: 拼起来是 PLAY，一起来玩！纸条没过去，意思已经到了。
lines.en: The letters spell PLAY. The note stayed behind, but the invitation got through.

lines.zh: 开玩前，米娅还藏了个小礼物。就在里奥面前的十个盒子里。
lines.en: Before the game, Mia hid a little gift in one of the ten boxes in Leo's treehouse.

lines.zh: 他们先约好一套是否问题。里奥按顺序提问，米娅用珠子回答。
lines.en: They agreed on a set of yes-or-no questions. Leo follows it. Mia replies with a gold or blue ball.

lines.zh: 如果挨个问，是一号吗，是二号吗，没猜中的盒子还剩一大堆。
lines.en: Is it box one? Box two? If the answers are no, almost all the boxes remain.

lines.zh: 换个问法：号码比五大吗？是。前面五个盒子都不用看了。
lines.en: Try this: is the number greater than five? Yes. Five boxes disappear at once.

lines.zh: 比八大吗？否。现在只剩六、七、八。
lines.en: Greater than eight? No. Only six, seven and eight remain.

lines.zh: 比六大吗？是。剩下七和八。
lines.en: Greater than six? Yes. That leaves seven and eight.

lines.zh: 比七大吗？否。找到了，七号盒子！
lines.en: Greater than seven? No. There it is: box seven!

lines.zh: 三次是否回答，最多分出八种结果。十个盒子，装不下。
lines.en: Three yes-or-no answers can distinguish at most eight outcomes. That cannot cover ten boxes.

lines.zh: 四次最多能分出十六种。问题问得合适，最坏四次也能找出这十个里的任何一个。
lines.en: Four answers allow sixteen outcomes. With suitable questions, four always suffice for any of the ten boxes.

lines.zh: 就算有一千个，十次也够。前提是每次尽量把剩下的分成数量接近的两组。
lines.en: Even a thousand possibilities need only ten answers, if each question splits the remaining choices as evenly as possible.

lines.zh: 盒子找到了，里面是哪种点心？候选是香蕉、苹果、葡萄和西瓜。
lines.en: The box is found. Which snack is inside: a banana, an apple, grapes, or watermelon?

lines.zh: 先问，图上有红色吗？是。香蕉和葡萄先放一边。
lines.en: Is it red in these pictures? Yes. Put the banana and grapes aside.

lines.zh: 图上能看见种子吗？能，原来是这块西瓜。两问就找到了。
lines.en: Can you see seeds? Yes. It is the watermelon slice. Two questions found it.

lines.zh: 这里两问够用，是因为问题把它们分开了。随便问两个问题，可不一定行。
lines.en: Two questions work here because the questions separate the choices. Any two questions will not necessarily do.

lines.zh: 里奥举起西瓜，发回一颗金色的小球。米娅看见信号，也笑了。
lines.en: Leo holds up the watermelon and sends a gold one back. Message received! Mia smiles.

lines.zh: 用电灯也行：关掉表示零，打开表示一。
lines.en: The balls carry our message. A light can send the same signals: off for zero, on for one.

lines.zh: 到网页实验室里，点亮六十四和一，看看会不会出现 A。
lines.en: In the online lab, switch on sixty-four and one. See whether the letter A appears.

lines.zh: 也可以打印这张表。你写一条消息，给孩子解；再换孩子出题。
lines.en: Or print the table. Write a message for your child to decode, then let them make one for you.

lines.zh: 今天只试英文字母。一个字节有八位，不代表每种文字都一个字节就够。
lines.en: Today we tried English letters. Eight bits make a byte, but not every character fits in one byte.

lines.zh: 来 Lucas Academy 一起玩：如果你们之间也只有一根小管子，你最想给对方说什么？
lines.en: Join us at Lucas Academy. If you had only a tiny pipe between you, what would you tell your friend?
